description: Everything to know before driving into one country by campervan or car, in one call: entry rule and how long the person and the vehicle may stay (with passport), travel weather now and this week, fuel prices, tolls and vignettes, public holidays in the next 30 days, safety advice, power plugs, customs limits and food prices. Use it when someone asks what to know about a country, the nuances or a guide for travelling there, or is preparing a trip to it; use the single-topic tools for one narrow question.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country, e.g. ES.

locale.description: Language the user writes in (en, ru, de, fr, es, pt, tr). Set it on every call: the answer and the interactive card are shown in this language and units; without it the card falls back to the app's interface language.

passport.description: Traveller's passport, ISO alpha-2 — adds the entry rule and how long the person and the vehicle may stay. Only if the user gave it.

name: get_country_travel_brief
title: Country Road-Trip Briefing
